summary.data_preservation_status_detail: implementation_metadata[]/reference_identities[] now exist (docs/research/erratum-v2-representation-gaps.md); metadata_not_preserved_ids and reference_identity_not_preserved_ids below are empty, meaning every candidate v2 round-trips its v1 metadata/identity exactly. No data/errata/*.json record has been migrated - this is a readiness finding about the REPRESENTATION, not a migration status.

representative_occurrences.value: In a period format a random hit on a monster that cannot be Special Summoned should leave that card in the hand, but the shipped modern card sends it to the GY, giving Lightsworn/Dark Armed style hands free Graveyard setup off the opponent's attack.

Stat erratum, not an effect change: the original MFC-060 printing had 1300 ATK and DR1-EN115 corrected it to 1500 ATK - the lineage's raw entries show ATK/1300 deleted and ATK/1500 inserted while the effect text is word-for-word unchanged between v0 and v1. Upstream carries the difference in card data only: cards-unofficial.cdb 511006010 is ATK 1300 / DEF 1300 against cards.cdb 55821894 at ATK 1500 / DEF 1300, and pre-errata/c511006010.lua is behaviourally identical to official/c55821894.lua (single EFFECT_AVOID_BATTLE_DAMAGE effect; the packet's script diff is empty and the files differ only by a name comment).

In a period format Anteatereatingant should be unrevivable by Monster Reborn/Call of the Haunted and should be able to blow up a Spell/Trap more than once per turn (at the price of not attacking); the shipped card is revivable after a proper summon and is capped at one destruction per turn.

In a period format Armored Glass should neither be activatable off, nor shut down, a Union monster equipped to a monster or an equipping Trap - only Equip Spells - whereas the shipped card negates every Equip Card on the field.

In Edison, Sirocco's boost is printed with no expiry and with no phase restriction on its use, so a Blackwing pumped by it should keep the ATK past the End Phase and the effect should be usable in Main Phase 2; the shipped card expires the gain at end of turn and refuses the effect outside Main Phase 1.

The English/TCG card has carried the leave-field return clause since its first printing, so the modern script is period-correct for every TCG snapshot; upstream's historical variant reproduces an OCG-only text that no TCG printing ever had and must not be substituted.
